headline: Braskem Third-Quarter Main Chemical Sales in Brazil Fall 18%
summary: Braskem recorded an 18% decline in sales of key chemical products in Brazil during the third quarter. In contrast, sales dipped 1% in the United States and expanded 9% in Mexico.
why: Braskem is the largest petrochemical producer in the Americas. Its domestic sales figures indicate underlying industrial and plastics manufacturing demand across the Brazilian market.

impacts.name: Braskem S.A.
impacts.why: Double-digit volume declines in its home market suppress Braskem's quarterly consolidated revenue.
